name: Centre Stone
description: An old waystone at the heart of the continent, between Greenvale and the Emberpeaks.

name: North-West Chest
description: Half-buried in snow on the Isle of Thorns. The Rusty Key opens it.

name: South-East Chest
description: Hidden on Lantern Isle, in the far south-east.

name: Rusty Key
description: Lost in the Mirewood marshes. Opens the North-West Chest.

name: East Bench
description: A rest stop near the eastern coast. Not something you collect, so it can't be checked off.

name: Frosthelm
description: The frozen north: tundra, pine forest and snowbound peaks.

name: Greenvale
description: Rolling grassland and old woods around Mirror Lake, at the heart of the continent.

name: Emberpeaks
description: A long mountain chain. Its rivers run down to the eastern sea.

name: Sunscar Wastes
description: Sun-baked dunes and dry hills in the south.

name: Mirewood
description: Marsh and thick forest on the south-western peninsula.

name: Isle of Thorns
description: A cold island off the north-west coast.

name: Lantern Isle
description: A small island in the far south-east.

name: Frostpeak Chest
description: Hint: where the river is born, climb until the snow turns to stone. It's by the peak that leans left.

name: Twin Peaks Chest
description: Hint: halfway down the Emberpeaks, wedged between two peaks that look like twins.

name: Woodland Chest
description: Hint: follow the edge of the woods towards the desert. It waits under the last tall oak.

name: North Shore Pier
description: Calm water at dawn. Silverfin bite here.

name: Reed Bank
description: Shallow reeds where the pike hide.

name: Old Copper Mine
description: Abandoned when the snows came. Bring a lantern.

name: Glittering Mine
description: Crystals on the walls catch the desert sun.

name: Deepiron Mine
description: The deepest shaft in the Emberpeaks. Listen for the echo.
